implementation.scope: Two instruction-ordered lfs/stfs triplet transfers, including sequential overlapping writes, f0 widening and a destination flag store. Selected cached x64 FPSCR flush bits and the host-control callback are modeled.

validation.tested_scope: One disjoint and one cascading overlap per entry; finite values, negative zero and infinity; high guest-pointer/register bits, selected GPR/FPR and cached x64 FPSCR, host flush-control callback and ordinary RAM.
validation.unvalidated_scope: Signaling NaNs, subnormals, other FP inputs, host exceptions and unselected ABI/FP state, non-x64 host control, faults, MMIO, concurrency and runtime behavior.
